title: Finite etale covers and finite locally constant sheaves
statement:
Let $Y$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with a geometric point $\bar y\to Y$ [def-weil-geometric-point]. Write $\mathrm{F\acute Et}(Y)$ for the category of finite etale $Y$-schemes, with $Y$-morphisms; finite and etale use the conventions of [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Write $\mathrm{FLC}(Y)$ for the category of finite locally constant sheaves of finite sets on the small etale site $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], where finite locally constant has the meaning in [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], with morphisms of sheaves. For $\mathcal F\in\mathrm{FLC}(Y)$ and $P\in\mathrm{F\acute Et}(Y)$ write

$$
\mathcal F_{\bar y},\qquad |P_{\bar y}|
$$

for the fibre at $\bar y$; an $M$-torsor is as in [def-weil-pbc-finite-torsors].
